name: Qwen3.8-27B Heretic, uncensored (NVFP4 W4A16)
notes: Verified on 2 × DGX Spark 2026-10-08: correct answers in English and Swedish, tool calls work, ~22 tok/s for one stream (thinking off), weights load in 40 s (9 GiB per node), 2.35M tokens of KV cache at 256k context (8.96x) with 0.70, and the head keeps ~25 GB available. Abliterated (Heretic) Qwen3.8-27B: dense, hybrid linear/full attention, refusals removed. ModelOpt NVFP4 weights with 16-bit activations (W4A16), run with the FP4 Marlin kernel on vLLM's official image (vLLM 0.29.1, multi-node without Ray). The vision tower is skipped with --language-model-only. Thinking is on by default; turn it off per request with chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false}.
